Stance / NLI (entailment-contradiction-neutral) NLI cross-encoders (roberta/bart/deberta-mnli) + zero-shot stance + deterministic negation/numeric-flip rules — the deterministic tier for 'do these two statements contradict?' before any LLM

Forecasting / time-series / temporal anomaly statsmodels (ARIMA/ETS) / Prophet / sktime / Darts / pmdarima / GluonTS / tslearn / PyOD — trained deterministic forecasters + anomaly detectors (the classical tier for prediction, not an LLM)
